from collections import Counter
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    common=[v for v,n in counts.most_common(2)]
    bg=next((v for v,n in counts.most_common() if v!=0),0)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in common]
    rs=sorted({r for r,c in pts}); cs=sorted({c for r,c in pts})
    dr=reduce(gcd,(b-a for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:])),0)
    dc=reduce(gcd,(b-a for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:])),0)
    rlines=list(range(rs[0],rs[-1]+1,dr)); clines=list(range(cs[0],cs[-1]+1,dc))
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(rlines,rlines[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in zip(clines,clines[1:]):
            vals=[grid[r0][c0],grid[r0][c1],grid[r1][c0],grid[r1][c1]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals.count(vals[0])==4 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    from math import gcd
    from functools import reduce
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common={v for v,_ in counts.most_common(2)}
    bg=9 if 9 in common else next((v for v,_ in counts.most_common() if v != 0),0)
    points=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in common]
    rows=sorted({r for r,c in points}); cols=sorted({c for r,c in points})
    dr=reduce(gcd,(b-a for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:])),0)

from functools import reduce
from math import gcd


def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    common = {value for value, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    background = 9 if 9 in common else next(
        (value for value, _ in counts.most_common() if value != 0), 0
    )

    marked = [
        (r, c)
        for r, row in enumerate(grid)
        for c, value in enumerate(row)
        if value not in common
    ]
    rows = sorted({r for r, _ in marked})
    cols = sorted({c for _, c in marked})
    row_step = reduce(gcd, (b - a for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:])), 0)
    col_step = reduce(gcd, (b - a for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:])), 0)
    row_lines = list(range(rows[0], rows[-1] + 1, row_step))
    col_lines = list(range(cols[0], cols[-1] + 1, col_step))

    return [
        [
            grid[r0][c0]
            if grid[r0][c0] == grid[r0][c1] == grid[r1][c0] == grid[r1][c1]
            else background
            for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:])
        ]
        for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:])
    ]
